question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3
solution: The correct answer is **"Representations".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • "(3)___________ to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and 4()" • Let's see the meanings of the given words- • **Illustrations: **a drawing, diagram, or picture in a book or magazine.(पुस्‍तक या पत्रिका में आरेखन, आरेख या चित्र) • **Representations**: a person or group that speaks or acts for or in support of another person or group(प्रतिनिधित्व) • **Delegations:** a group of people who have been chosen to speak or take decisions for a larger group of people, especially at a meeting.(सम्मेलन आदि में किसी बड़े समूह की ओर से बोलने अथवा निर्णय लेने के लिए चयनित एक छोटा समूह, प्रतिनिधि मंडल) • **Exhibitions:** in the most general sense, is an organized presentation and display of a selection of items.(प्रदर्शनी, नुमाइश) • **Representations** to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers signify that the sports minister is speaking on behalf of chief ministers and representing other sports ministers. • Therefore, the correct answer is** option 2.** • Hence, the correct passage will be- *Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports awards. The debate that arises every year following the announcement of the awards often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism, and manipulations.** Representations** to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and (4)___________by the politicians have all become part of the (5)_____________. * 44:Ta12, The correct answer is **"Interventions".**
